Petitioner/s

Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Mohit Agarwal, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Parmeshwar Mehta, A.P.P.

=
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Arvind Srivastava
 Oral Order
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Purnia Sadar P.S. Case No. 42 of 2022 registered for the offences under Sections 409, 419 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 7(1) (a) (ii) &
9(ii) of the Essential Commodities Act and Section 35 (1) (a) & 35 (1) (b) of the Fertilizers Act, 1955.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the instant case.
Further submission is that the petitioner's proprietary concern's certificate of registration / license is valid till 30.03.2025 as contained in Annexure-2 of the petition.

Further on dated 13.01.2022 the petitioner vide his representation (Annexure-3) to the Sub-Divisional Agriculture Officer, Purnea gave clarification and requested for retest of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.29644 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023 'referee' but the same was ignored and the FIR was lodged.

The petitioner had applied for the endorsement of the fertilizer in question in the license of the petitioner vide Form-O dated 01.12.2021 (Annexure-4) which is also endorsed by the Department as annexed at Annexure-5.

It is also submitted that the Joint Director, Agriculture after observation of the petitioner's representation dated 27.01.2022 (Annexure 6) vide its Memo No. 535 dated 26.04.2022 (Annexure 6/A) held that the petitioner is not liable for the alleged fertilizer.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties, the petitioner, above named is directed to be released on bail, in the event of arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of four weeks from today, on furnishing Bishwanath Agrawal vs The State Of Bihar on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77989803/
1 bail bonds of Rs.10,000/-(ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of S.D.J.M., Purnea in connection with Purnia Sadar P.S. Case No. 42 of 2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
(Arvind Srivastava, J) anuradha/-
